trait_definition: Neurolucida complexity index of the pial ILA arbor, averaged per species; Complexity = [sum of the terminal orders + number of terminals] * [total dendritic length / number of primary dendrites] (after Pillai et al. 2012)

transformation_method: Complexity formula as specified in the Table 2 trait definition

trait_definition: presence of pial interlaminar astrocytes (ILA) in the DORSAL frontal cortex: Yes = typical pial ILA (interlaminar processes exit layer I and course through the cortical laminae); rudimetary = rudimentary pial ILA (inverted-pyramidal soma contacting the pia with at least one process coursing towards layer II but not exiting layer I); No = neither observed
measurement_method: GFAP immunohistochemistry on frontal cerebral cortex; interlaminar processes traced in thin sections back to their soma of origin, then scored per species as typical / rudimentary / absent, separately for pial vs subpial cell type and for dorsal vs ventral cortex
method_evidence: Falcone_etal_2019/reference_tables/Falcone_etal_2019_TABLE1_definitions.csv Materials and Methods sec. 2.5 (Imaging) and Results sec. 3.1-3.2, pp. 1658-1662; antibody details sec. 2.4
